finding.text: Ask 3 ("Turn PromptTasks on") was not done: `node Servex/agents/PromptTasks.js status` still says `off (…\servex\prompt-tasks.off present)`. The diff only documents the switch. Run `on` after the merge, or say in the brief that the mastermind runs it then. As written, the map's line "PromptTasks is on while the file is absent" (prompt-refinement-map.md:5) reads as if it is on now, and it is not.
Stale comment: `Server/PromptRecords.mjs:231` still says "One Haiku call" for `attach_to`, which now runs on `this.def.parts.model`. For the live process that is Sonnet.

Stale docs the diff did not update: `ext/Refine/doc/prompt-records.md:37` says the parts step is "Haiku, one call per prompt", and `core/Session/doc/prompt-breakdown.md:8` says "one Haiku call (`attach_to`)". Both are now Sonnet for live (Haiku for review).

The single-ask gap (a prompt with one ask is never matched to an open task, `PromptRecords.mjs:201` `todo.length >= 2`) is noted only in a sentence of prompt-refinement-map.md:5. The brief says to "log it as a gap", so it should be a task on the session record, or it will be lost.

The task never landed. session.jsonl ends with "session ended (other) without landing", and it has no outcome line and no answer to "report whether it needs a Servex restart". A fresh agent cannot tell from this folder that commit 325571642 sits unmerged on `worktree/refiner-step2`.

The new test `Server/PromptRecords.live.test.mjs` passes (`PromptRecords.live.test: ok`), but `Server/readme.md` does not list it. Other tests are named there (lines 36, 53–56). Add it to the PromptRecords line.
The `LIVE_MODEL` comment (`PromptRecords.mjs:36`) says one line switches it back. That is true, but it also moves `attach_to` for live. That is fine; the refinement map should just say so.
